verdict.rationale: Evidence shows reporting dashboards, ML-powered fraud detection, and an MCP server for LLM natural-language queries, but nothing indicates Adyen surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions natively inside its own product UI (e.g., proactive recommendations, anomaly explanations, or generated analysis in the Customer Area). Missing for 10: evidence of in-product AI-generated insights/suggestions, any generative AI feature description, or documented output examples from such a feature.
